description: Kill a CLI/connector token. Whatever is using it stops working immediately and it cannot be restored — including, possibly, the credential this MCP server is running on. `confirm` must be the token id exactly. Use the user's explicit authorization for this action and target. Ask if it is missing. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: The exact token id for this irreversible action. Supply it only when the user explicitly authorized this action on this target. Otherwise ask for their decision.

name: fillo_revoke_token
title: Revoke a connector token
